sql: SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trips, ROUND(AVG(yt / (anglers + 1)), 4) as avg_yt_per_angler FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 260 GROUP BY fish_date_doy ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC
